name: Hotel Narsarsuaq
description: Narsarsuaq is the meeting place for the entire South Greenland and is an attractive destination with short distance to the many towns, experiences and historic sites which characterise the area. In the summer direct flights from Denmark and Iceland make it possible to give guests from Europe and North America new experiences which combine the luscious nature with a wide range of opportunities for experiences. Hotel Narsarsuaq is a modern hotel with 93 rooms and 220 beds in individual rooms, double rooms, family rooms and suites. Guests in the hotel’s restaurant on the top floor can enjoy an amazing view of the fjord and mountains. There is also a cafeteria and a hotel bar. The plenum room can seat 45 participants for meetings, courses and conferences with a beautiful view of the fjord and access to all modern conference facilities.
